label: Elevation (1 km)
source: NASADEM / Copernicus DEM elevation at ~1 km (data/raw/ss_nasadem_elev_1km_fast.tif)
notes: The county series elevation_mean (Copernicus GLO-90 read at ~370 m) is reproduced by averaging this 1 km grid over each county (r = 0.99999, mean difference 0.06 m). Map: continuous colour from the 2nd (red) to the 98th (green) percentile; white = middle.
colormap: continuous red -> white -> green (red = low / decrease, white = middle / no change, green = high / increase); 2nd-98th percentile of all dates
smoothing: average of the grid cells in each display pixel
